retrievalProfile.description: A vertical text-heavy layout featuring a subject wearing a pattern that is mirrored within the display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-key portrait of a blonde woman in a polka-dot dress, leaning against a wall, with large vertical text on the left that shares the dress's pattern and smaller horizontal text across the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Pattern matching between subject's clothing and display typography
Vertical orientation of primary text contrasting with horizontal secondary text
Subject's pose leaning into the frame from the right
Soft, diffused outdoor lighting with a shallow depth of field
coreInvariants: Polka dot pattern fill in the primary vertical text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, full torso view, leaning against a vertical surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large vertical text on the left acts as a heavy visual anchor balancing the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large vertical text, move to the subject's face, then down to the horizontal title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright, out-of-focus background provides airy negative space between the text and the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light blue (background and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, bright exposure with high contrast in the patterns.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text is vertically stacked and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise
Primary text uses a polka dot pattern fill matching the subject's dress
Secondary text is a bold slab serif with a drop shadow
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in primary text are clipped to a uniform width to form a vertical column
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a large, patterned sans-serif and a small, solid-colored slab serif.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows for legibility against busy backgrounds

preserve: Vertical orientation of the main name
Yellow accent color for the title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric circular counters needed for the vertical text skeleton.
Matches the sturdy slab serif characteristics of the horizontal subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key outdoor portrait of a blonde woman in a black and white polka dot dress leaning against a white wall in a sunlit alleyway.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large vertical text on the left with a polka dot fill and a soft shadow. Add a horizontal yellow slab-serif title across the middle with a hard black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Does the text pattern match the dress pattern?
Is the primary text rotated 90 degrees vertically?
Is the yellow text legible against the background?
Is the lighting bright and high-key?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Effective use of drop shadows for depth
avoid: Clashing patterns between text and clothing

postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is aligned to the left margin.
Ensure the polka dots in the text are sharp and distinct.
Verify the yellow text has a visible black drop shadow.
Confirm the subject is positioned on the right side of the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in patterned clothing + Typography masked with same pattern + High-key lighting + Vertical/Horizontal text contrast.
